summary: Transglobal Management Group disclosed an October 2, 2026 Control Share Purchase Agreement in which Third Life World, LLC (managing member Jorge Guinovart) bought all 200 Series A Preferred shares from Marc and Jacquie Angell for $140,000, gaining 80% of aggregate voting power — a change-in-control transaction mapped to a US control-stake acquisition. The Company issued eight Series B Preferred shares to the Sellers, retained Marc Angell as a consultant for three months at $5,000 monthly plus a $115,000 one-time bonus, and assumed public-company expense and technology-contribution obligations. Closing conditions include the Unwind Closing, Certificate of Designation filing and closing payments; watch regulatory and unwind risk.
